summary.text: Ajay Gupta is the Republican candidate for the Illinois House of Representatives, District 41, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Democrat Janet Yang Rohr.
An attorney and professor, he says his priorities include pension reform, changes to Illinois' pretrial detention rules and limits on state spending.

paragraphs.text: Ajay Gupta earned a graduate degree from Yale University in 1990, a law degree from Harvard Law School in 1993, and a graduate degree from Stanford University in 1997.
His career experience includes working as an attorney and professor.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he has more than 30 years of experience practicing and teaching tax, securities and criminal law.
Gupta advanced from the Republican primary on March 17, 2026.

In the survey, he said he would push a constitutional path to stabilize Illinois' pension systems and have the state assume teacher-pension costs, reverse the SAFE-T Act's pretrial policies so high-risk defendants can be detained pending trial, and tie appropriations to inflation and population growth while opposing new tax increases.
